description: This file contains French (Canada) localization data for the DateJS library, including culture-specific date formats, names of days and months, and parsing patterns.

methods.name: clearTime
methods.description: Clears the time portion of the date, setting hours, minutes, seconds, and milliseconds to zero.

methods.name: setTimeToNow
methods.description: Sets the time portion of the date to the current system time.

methods.name: clone
methods.description: Creates a copy of the date object.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this date to another date.

methods.name: equals
methods.description: Checks if this date is equal to another date.

methods.name: getDayNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the day of the week given in various formats.

methods.name: getMonthNumberFromName
methods.description: Returns the index of the month given in various formats.

methods.name: isLeapYear
methods.description: Determines if a year is a leap year.

methods.name: getDaysInMonth
methods.description: Returns the number of days in a given month and year.

methods.name: getTimezoneAbbreviation
methods.description: Returns the abbreviation name for a timezone offset.

methods.name: getTimezoneOffset
methods.description: Returns the timezone offset for a given timezone name.
